### Declarations (both in `namespace AlgebraicGeometry`, term-mode one-liners)
1. `mem_picRankOneOpen_iff_isSplitWitness (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom) {K} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K)) : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) ↔ IsSplitWitness C lam.1` — the two landed directions paired: `⟨isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field pi ·, mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness pi hpi lam⟩`.
2. `isSplitWitness_testPoint_of_mem (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj (op T)} (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op T)) (t : T.left) : IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) lam.1)` — `isSplitWitness_of_mem_picRankOneOpen_field pi (picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.testPoint t).op h)`. The pullback lands at the field base `overSpec k (Over.testPointField t)` (which carries the required `Field`/`Algebra k` instances); the underlying class `((picDegLayerFunctor …).map (Over.testPoint t).op lam).1` is *definitionally* `picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) lam.1`, so no compatibility rewrite is needed.

Deliverable 2 correctly does **not** take `hpi` — its proof genuinely does not use it (matching the task's "explicitly where needed"). Deliverable 1 takes `hpi` (needed for the backward `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness`).
